contract_purpose: Defines the exact inputs Layer C consumes, the exact outputs it produces, and the traceability invariants every structural assertion must satisfy.

layer_a_observations.description: Font-aware glyph classifications from font_aware_math_classifier.py (frozen v1.0). Layer C does NOT re-classify glyphs.

source_pdf.description: MuPDF document handle for rawdict extraction. The same doc handle is passed to both v2 and v3.

page_width_pt.description: Page width in PDF points from page.rect.width, used for equation-number position thresholds.

outputs.output_format: JSON file per page, identical top-level schema to v2.0_hierarchical for direct comparison

equation_number_metadata.description: Decoupled equation-number record (AC-4). Present only when has_equation_number is true.

math_expression_bbox.description: Tight bounding box around the mathematical expression only, excluding equation-number label and inter-label whitespace.

structural_provenance.description: Traceability record linking every structural assertion to its contributing evidence (AC-traceability).

improvement_1_adaptive_baseline.v2_defect: Rigid 3.0 pt centre-y tolerance splits subscripts/superscripts at |Δy| = 3.1–3.3 pt

improvement_2_equation_number_decoupling.v2_defect: Equation numbers merged into single monolithic merged_bbox, penalizing expression IoU by up to 130 pt of whitespace
improvement_2_equation_number_decoupling.v3_rule: Detect trailing '(N)' patterns on right margin; emit as equation_number_metadata with separate label_bbox; compute math_expression_bbox excluding the label

improvement_3_multiline_guardrails.v2_defect: Level 5 merges any two vertically adjacent equation lines within 16 pt, regardless of semantic continuity
improvement_3_multiline_guardrails.v3_rule: Require at least one of: (a) shared relation symbol (=, ≤, etc.) alignment within 5 pt horizontal, (b) indented continuation (second line x0 > first line x0 + 20 pt), (c) explicit punctuation continuation (first line ends with +, -, =, comma). Do NOT merge lines that both begin with independent relation symbols at similar indentation.

comparison_protocol.step_1: Run frozen v2 (hierarchical_region_proposals.py) on each page. Record v2 proposals.
comparison_protocol.step_2: Run candidate v3 (hierarchical_region_proposals_v3.py) on each page, consuming the SAME Layer A observations. Record v3 proposals.
comparison_protocol.step_3: For each gold equation, find best-matching proposal from v2 and v3 independently.
comparison_protocol.step_4: Compute per-equation delta: IoU_v3 - IoU_v2, structural_checks_v3 - structural_checks_v2.
comparison_protocol.step_5: Report per-equation verdicts: IMPROVED, UNCHANGED, REGRESSED.
comparison_protocol.step_6: Accept only if: zero REGRESSED on any equation, zero negative-control escapes, and at least one IMPROVED equation across the ViLT population (where v2 scored 0/6 PRESERVED).
